hero.headline: Our room. Your practice.
hero.intro: The studio is vacant on Saturdays and Sundays for yoga teachers, workshop leaders, sound healing practitioners, and creative movements to gather, host, or practice together.

features: 10 aerial silk rigging points with tested carabiners
Tibetan singing bowls, gong, chimes & sound instruments
Premium high-density yoga mats, organic cotton bolsters, blocks
Dual aspect natural light with privacy sheer shades
Full studio Bluetooth sound system and ambient dimmers
